list.title: engraving.Score
list.description: Class representing a score. We can get the current score by calling the api.engraving.curScore

list.title: engraving.Score.scoreName
list.description: Name of the score, without path leading to it and extension.

list.title: engraving.Score.title
list.description: Title of score, as taken from the score properties workTitle

list.title: engraving.Score.composer
list.description: Composer of the score, as taken from the score properties

list.title: engraving.Score.lyricist
list.description: Lyricist of score, as taken from the score properties.

list.title: engraving.Score.duration
list.description: Duration of score in seconds

list.title: engraving.Score.mscoreVersion
list.description: MuseScore version the score has been last saved with (includes autosave)

list.title: engraving.Score.mscoreRevision
list.description: MuseScore revision the score has been last saved with (includes autosave)

list.title: engraving.Score.style
list.description: Style settings for this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.keysig
list.description: Key signature at the start of the score, in number of accidentals, negative for flats, positive for sharps

list.title: engraving.Score.npages
list.description: Number of pages

list.title: engraving.Score.pages
list.description: List of pages in this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.pageNumberOffset
list.description:
Page numbering offset. The user-visible number of the given page is defined as

page.pagenumber + 1 + score.pageNumberOffset

list.title: engraving.Score.parts
list.description: The list of parts

list.title: engraving.Score.nstaves
list.description: Number of staves

list.title: engraving.Score.staves
list.description: List of staves in this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.ntracks
list.description: Number of tracks

list.title: engraving.Score.systems
list.description: List of systems in this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.spanners
list.description: List of spanners (hairpins, slurs, etc.) in this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.hasHarmonies
list.description: Whether score has harmonies (chord symbols)

list.title: engraving.Score.harmonyCount
list.description: Number of harmony items (chord symbols) in the score

list.title: engraving.Score.hasLyrics
list.description: Whether score has lyrics

list.title: engraving.Score.lyricCount
list.description: Number of lyrics items (syllables) in the score

list.title: engraving.Score.lyrics
list.description: List of lyrics in this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.nmeasures
list.description: Number of measures

list.title: engraving.Score.firstMeasure
list.description: First measure of the score

list.title: engraving.Score.firstMeasureMM
list.description: First multimeasure rest measure of the score

list.title: engraving.Score.lastMeasure
list.description: Last measure of the score

list.title: engraving.Score.lastMeasureMM
list.description: Last multimeasure rest measure of the score

list.title: engraving.Score.lastSegment
list.description: Last score segment

list.title: engraving.Score.layoutMode
list.description: The current layout mode, a PluginAPI::LayoutMode value.

list.title: engraving.Score.showVerticalFrames
list.description: Whether vertical frames are visible in the current layout mode.

list.title: engraving.Score.showInvisible
list.description: Whether invisible elements are shown in the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.showUnprintable
list.description: Whether formatting elements are displayed in the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.showFrames
list.description: Whether frames are displayed in the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.showPageborders
list.description: Whether page borders are displayed in the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.showSoundFlags
list.description: Whether sound flags are displayed in the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.markIrregularMeasures
list.description: Whether corrupted measures are marked in the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.showInstrumentNames
list.description: Whether instrument names are displayed

list.title: engraving.Score.selection
list.description: Current selections for the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.excerpts
list.description: List of the excerpts (linked parts)

list.title: engraving.Score.metaTag
list.description: Get the value of a meta tag by name

list.title: engraving.Score.setMetaTag
list.description: Set a value of a meta tag by name

list.title: engraving.Score.appendPart
list.description: Appends a part with the instrument defined by instrumentId to this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.appendPartByMusicXmlId
list.description: Appends a part with the instrument defined by the given MusicXML ID to this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.addRemoveSystemLocks
list.description: Add or remove system locks to the current selection.

list.title: engraving.Score.makeIntoSystem
list.description: Create a (locked) system from two {@link engraving.Measure} objects.

list.title: engraving.Score.extractLyrics
list.description: Extracts all lyrics in the score and returns them in a single string.

list.title: engraving.Score.appendMeasures
list.description: Appends a number of measures to this score.

list.title: engraving.Score.tick2measure
list.description: The measure at a given tick in the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.firstSegment
list.description: The first segment of a given type in the score. Before MuseScore 4.6, the type could not be specified.

list.title: engraving.Score.findSegmentAtTick
list.description: Looks for a segment of a given type at a given tick. Does not create a segment or modify the score.

list.title: engraving.Score.addText
list.description: Add the text

list.title: engraving.Score.doLayout
list.description:
Force the score to layout itself. The score is laid out automatically at the end of a command, however this method can be called to layout mid-command. Layout the whole score with:

curScore.doLayout(fraction(0, 1), fraction(-1, 1))

list.title: engraving.Score.Cursor* newCursor
list.description: Creates and returns a cursor to be used to navigate in the score

list.title: engraving.Score.startCmd
list.description: For MuseScore 4 and for "dock" type plugins: to be used before score modifications to make them undoable, and to avoid corruptions or crashes. Starts an undoable command. Must be accompanied by a corresponding endCmd() call.

list.title: engraving.Score.endCmd
list.description: For MuseScore 4 and for "dock" type plugins: to be used after score modifications to make them undoable, and to avoid corruptions or crashes. Ends an undoable command.

list.title: engraving.Score.showElementInScore
list.description: Put an item in the user's view.

list.title: engraving.Score.createPlayEvents
list.description: Create PlayEvents for all notes based on ornamentation. You need to call this if you are manipulating PlayEvent's so that all ornamentations are populated into Note's PlayEvent lists.

list.title: engraving.Style
list.description: Provides an access to score style settings. Style settings for a score can be obtained by querying the Score.style property.

list.title: engraving.Style.value
list.description: Get the value of style by key. Key should be one of Sid values.

list.title: engraving.Style.setValue
list.description: Sets the value of style setting named key to value. Key should be one of Sid values.

list.title: engraving.Style.resetValue
list.description: Resets the value of style setting named key to its default. Key should be one of Sid values.

list.description: Access to the theme
